assumptions: Preview and final both use the published 720p Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash rate. Google says a draft can be 360p, and it does not publish a separate 360p price.
Each shot is quoted as two takes: one preview and one final.
The retake reserve is one extra preview of every priced shot. That is not a published fee. It counts against the production allocation.

A Gemini Omni clip shorter than 3 seconds is quoted at 3 seconds, and a clip longer than 15 seconds is split. Google publishes one-second lengths from 3 to 15. Shaping the call that way is an assumption.
Still frames are not priced. This card has no still-image rate, so the art-director line stays at $0.
Sound is not priced. This card has no audio-only rate, so the sound-designer line stays at $0.
Dailies review does not call a paid model in this build, so the review itself is $0. A retake is estimated as one preview and checked against the fix-loop line. It is not spent here.
The fix-loop reserve is the locked fix-loop allocation when the split has one. It is not a new price. If the split has no fix-loop line, the reserve is $0.
Color and mix are not priced. This card has no grade or mix rate, so a paid color or mix call is unknown. This build does not make one.
